summary_claims.claim: Government adopted the strategy on 5 March 2026 and asked for an action plan within nine months
Draft was in public consultation for 30 days from 17 November 2025

note: Title fix is supported by the Government's English release and the strategy text ('za umetno inteligenco'); the English translation is a government translation on gov.si and is stored. Notes match Priloga 2 (consultation from 17 November 2025, Economic and Social Council on 16 January per the page break). One search found no new strategy edition; the Slovenian AI Act implementing law is a separate instrument.
